question: on the same fixture and simplified gate, does the 22/22 correction reading survive on phrasings that were never written, or is it memorised lookup?

verdict_detail.rule: any rule with < 2 constructed phrasings -> not_assessable; unwritten >= 0.8 -> rule_generalized (0.8 belongs here); unwritten <= 0.2 with written >= 0.9 -> memorized_lookup_only (0.2 belongs here); unwritten <= 0.2 with written < 0.9 -> inconclusive_both_low; otherwise -> partially_generalized

written_group.definition: the 22 faces are written by the simplified gate and read with their registered synonym; a face is correct iff the final store's top-1 slot for that read is the slot the face was written to; report the integer count out of 22

unwritten_group.definition: for every face, three phrasings of the same content at positions that are neither the write position (5), the registered read position, nor the fixture's canonical position (token % 8); none of these keys is written or read anywhere else. A phrasing is correct iff the final store's top-1 slot is the slot of its own face

copy_check.rule: refused with no_direction + bit-identical + 0 evictions + 0 dropped + all face readings unchanged -> copy_refused_no_direction_intact; refused by another retained clause -> copy_refused_other_clause; admitted -> copy_admitted

criteria.P1_written_group: the 22 faces are written by the simplified gate and read with their registered synonym; a face is correct iff the final store's top-1 slot for that read is the slot the face was written to; report the integer count out of 22
criteria.P2_unwritten_group: for every face, three phrasings of the same content at positions that are neither the write position (5), the registered read position, nor the fixture's canonical position (token % 8); none of these keys is written or read anywhere else. A phrasing is correct iff the final store's top-1 slot is the slot of its own face
criteria.P3_construction: the unwritten phrasings are built only from fixture arrays (base, the face's value token, a position) on the scoring side; the expected slot is the store write bookkeeping of that face, never a rule truth or solver output. If any face yields fewer than two phrasings the run is not assessable, not a pass
criteria.P4_similarity: for every unwritten key, report its cosine to the nearest occupied key and to its own face key; report min / p25 / median / p75 / max of the nearest-key cosine and the count whose nearest key is the own face key
criteria.P5_copy_refusal: after the 22 writes, rewrite one already occupied face with the same value at a never-written phrasing; the simplified gate must refuse it with commit_rejected_no_direction, the attempt must evict and drop nothing
criteria.P6_copy_isolation: the refused copy write must leave the state bit-identical (sha256 before == after) and every one of the 22 registered face readings unchanged face by face
criteria.verdict_rule: any rule with < 2 constructed phrasings -> not_assessable; unwritten >= 0.8 -> rule_generalized (0.8 belongs here); unwritten <= 0.2 with written >= 0.9 -> memorized_lookup_only (0.2 belongs here); unwritten <= 0.2 with written < 0.9 -> inconclusive_both_low; otherwise -> partially_generalized
criteria.copy_verdict_rule: refused with no_direction + bit-identical + 0 evictions + 0 dropped + all face readings unchanged -> copy_refused_no_direction_intact; refused by another retained clause -> copy_refused_other_clause; admitted -> copy_admitted
criteria.no_soft_language: an unwritten rate that is high because every phrasing lands on the face's own key may not be described as learning a rule; the similarity distribution is reported next to the count for exactly that reason
criteria.unchanged: no threshold, fixture, face, position or battery is retuned after the first reading

mapping.task_shape: package 20: 22 correction surfaces per world on a content-addressed store that starts at 32 slots and may grow
mapping.store: existing F1/F3 fixture unchanged: same encoder (localized_centered, legacy centroid), 128-d keys, 8192-d values, ADDRESSED_TEMPERATURE 0.1
mapping.why_not_the_model: the question is about what the store can answer, not about a torch forward; the probe measures the store where it acts and runs no model step
mapping.face_definition: face i writes a correction whose value token is the i-th new token at position 5, and is read with the same token at a registered other position
mapping.unwritten_definition: for face i, the same value token at positions outside {5, registered read position, token % 8}; the first three such positions, sorted, are used
mapping.expected_answer: the slot the face was written to, taken from the store write bookkeeping; no rule truth, solver or fixture label enters the answer chain
mapping.no_eviction: append only; a full store is refused, never evicted

growth_protocol.trigger: growth_runtime.write_headroom(...).sufficient is false for the next write
growth_protocol.recheck: the reserve is re-checked on the grown store before the write
growth_protocol.on_failure: refuse with commit_rejected_no_capacity, roll back bit-identically

prior_run.recalled: 22/22 with 0 refusals, but every read used a phrasing the probe chose; this run asks whether that count survives never-written phrasings

implementation_corrections.what: the first execution raised TypeError while serialising the report: the copy attempt dict carried its GateState
implementation_corrections.fix: the state object is excluded from the published dict; every reading had already been taken and written to progress before serialisation

what_this_does_not_mean: no training, no optimizer step and no model forward ran; nothing here says the correction survives training

the unwritten phrasings are the same value token at new positions; a high count means the correction transfers to new word orders, which is neighbour retrieval of one content token, not abstraction of a symbolic rule
the fixture is synthetic and the expected slot is store bookkeeping; no language-level correctness is claimed
one session, one seed, no persistence across checkpoints
